threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'Stokey' and think the Newington Green is just a bit of grass, not a whole scene.
Heard a guy on the 36 bus last night talking about how his ex was dating a DJ, but he kept insisting he would ‘never be that guy’—and then he pulled out a mixtape.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: You know you're in Neukölln when the smell of döner and the sound of a street musician colliding with a baby crying is your morning wake-up call.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find people casually playing ping pong in the middle of a park while the tram rumbles past. It's a vibe you can't replicate.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they handle BART delays—real ones know to bring a snack and a book, not just a phone.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy serenading the 38 Geary crowd with a ukulele. Only in SF, where even bus stops become mini-concerts.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the true charm of Gràcia is just in the plazas, but it’s really the winding streets after dark where the real vibe unfolds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still marvel at the street performers in Plaça del Sol, oblivious to how quickly that sparkle fades.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'takeaway' instead of a 'chippy'. Locals know it’s all about the fish and chips on Saturday by the Kingsland Road.
Last night on the 59, a guy insisted he could read tarot cards with just a Snickers wrapper. He gave everyone a fortune, mostly about the weather.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy juggling flaming torches while waiting for the bus at Sonnenallee. Totally normal for a Tuesday evening!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find ‘Kiez’ pranks where locals sneak random items into public art pieces, just to watch tourists puzzled by the additions.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You see someone tip their barista in pesos—definite local. If they say ‘Civic Center’ like ‘Civ-ic Senter’, they’re probably just in town for work.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in flip-flops catch a Muni bus by jumping off a skateboard. Just another day in the Outer Sunset, where the unexpected is the norm.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think all the tapas are the same. But true locals know that the real gems are those hidden bars with family recipes passed down for generations.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them still trying to pay with cash in cafes where it's card only. Classic rookie move, like tourists at the Sagrada!
